_original_lore: The Bal is a Boss located within Khazad-dûm
in the Crystal Hollows. It guards the Topaz Crystal.
It takes 1 health of damage per hit,
regardless of which weapon is used. At various points
in the fight Bal will summon Fire Bats and Blazes.
name: 巴尔 (首领)

source: The Bal is a Boss located within Khazad-dûm
in the Crystal Hollows. It guards the Topaz Crystal.
loreParagraphs.translation: 巴尔是位于水晶洞窟中卡扎督姆内的首领.它守护着黄玉水晶.
